log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Opponent has strong Steel core (Gholdengo, Corviknight, Kingambit). Bring Garchomp lead (EQ/rocks hits steels), Gholdengo (Good as Gold blocks status, Make It Rain), Primarina (Fairy for Kingambit/Dragapult). Dragapult scarf risky vs their Dragapult; leave home.

Bring Dragapult (scarf, fast lead), Gholdengo, and Kingambit/Garchomp as options. Opponent has Gholdengo, Dragapult, Garchomp, Kingambit, Primarina, Glimmora. Plan: Dragapult leads, then Garchomp mega to sweep. Watch for opposing Glimmora's Toxic Debris.

Dragapult may outspeed and can't be EQ'd (Ghost/Levitate-like). Set rocks first; Dragapult likely U-turn/Dragon move. Then bring Gholdengo to wall/hit it (Shadow Ball) or Primarina for Kingambit later. Watch for their Gholdengo/Corviknight steels — Garchomp EQ handles them.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Dragapult likely faster; EQ doesn't hit it. Scaleshot hits SE but weak. Stealth Rock is safe vs Ghost.

decisions.thought: Turn 1: Dragapult (scarf) leads into their Garchomp. Dracometeor should KO it or nearly. After that, switch out of the scarf lock and the SpA drop. Gholdengo is good against their Dragapult and Garchomp. Garchomp is my mega sweeper.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
My Dragapult is scarf-locked into Draco Meteor against Garchomp, so I'm calculating the damage - it's super effective dragon STAB with 130 base power, and with 152 SpA versus Garchomp's bulk this should deal heavy damage, likely in the 60-70% range depending on whether it mega evolves.

With 90% accuracy this probably OHKOs unless Garchomp is unusually bulky, though the SpA drop afterward means I'll need to switch out next turn.

decisions.thought: Garchomp died turn 1 to scarf/spec Dragapult Draco (SpA now -2). Send Gholdengo: resists nothing but takes Draco neutrally, Good as Gold blocks status, Shadow Ball hits Dragapult hard. Primarina saved for Kingambit/Dragapult. Watch for U-turn into their steels; keep Primarina healthy for Kingambit.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Dragapult -2 SpA. Gholdengo resists Draco? Dragon vs Steel/Ghost: neutral. Primarina resists Dragon. Bring Gholdengo in to threaten Shadow Ball; Dragapult may U-turn. Gholdengo is key vs steels; Primarina handles Dragapult/Kingambit. Send Gholdengo.

decisions.thought: Garchomp dead turn 1 to Dragapult Draco (SpA -2). Gholdengo full HP, Life Orb. Shadow Ball SE on Dragapult, likely big chunk/KO. Dragapult may U-turn into Kingambit/Corviknight — Make It Rain then hits those. Keep Primarina healthy for Kingambit; watch their remaining 2 picks.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Shadow Ball hits Dragapult hard (SE, ~likely KO with Life Orb). Dragapult may U-turn or Draco. Shadow Ball is best.

decisions.thought: Turn 2: Dragapult is locked into Draco Meteor by its scarf and is at -2 SpA. Switching to Garchomp to answer their Gholdengo with Earthquake. Next: Mega Evolve Garchomp, then Swords Dance or Earthquake. Their last Pokémon is still unknown (dragapult, kingambit, primarina or glimmora). Keep Gholdengo for their Dragapult.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Since Dragapult is locked into Draco Meteor, I'm considering switching to Garchomp against Gholdengo—its attacks hit Garchomp neutrally, while Garchomp's Earthquake would hit Gholdengo super effectively.

decisions.thought: Garchomp dead turn 1 to Dragapult Draco. Gholdengo 148/164 w/ Life Orb. Opp Garchomp at 32%: Make It Rain (SE, LO) should KO. Dragapult (SpA -2) still healthy, likely switches in — Shadow Ball next. Primarina saved for Kingambit/Dragapult. Their 3rd pick unknown (Kingambit/Corviknight/Gholdengo/Incineroar). Watch SpA drops stacking; Recover if low.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp at 32%: Make It Rain likely KOs (SE, 120 BP, Life Orb). Dragapult may come in. Make It Rain drops SpA but KO worth it.

decisions.thought: Turn 3: Mega Garchomp uses Earthquake into their Life Orb Gholdengo (90% HP) and should KO it. Garchomp is at 60 HP and outspeeds it. Their last Pokémon is still unknown (dragapult, kingambit, primarina or glimmora). Keep my Gholdengo for their Dragapult. My Dragapult is scarfed, locked into Draco on entry, and at -2 SpA.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
My Garchomp is faster and Earthquake is super effective against Gholdengo, who's at 90% HP. I'm calculating whether Mega Garchomp's boosted Attack and STAB Earthquake can secure the knockout against Gholdengo's Defense of 103.

Working through the damage, I'm getting an estimated 260-ish hit, which should comfortably KO Gholdengo's 175 HP, and Mega Garchomp still outspeeds even after its stat changes. Mega evolve and Earthquake.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Garchomp dead turn 1 to Dragapult Draco; Gholdengo KO'd by Mega Garchomp EQ. Primarina full HP. Moonblast should KO 32% Garchomp; Dragapult likely comes in after — Moonblast also hits it SE. Keep Calm Mind for later vs Kingambit/Corviknight. Watch Dragapult speed (145-213) outspeeds Primarina.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp at 32%, Moonblast likely KOs. Dragapult may come in after. Moonblast.

decisions.thought: Turn 4: Primarina is their last Pokémon. Mega Garchomp (60 HP, faster) uses Earthquake for heavy damage; Dragon Claw is useless against Fairy. If Garchomp faints, bring Gholdengo (resists Fairy) to finish it, with scarf Dragapult as backup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Their last Pokémon is Primarina, and I'm checking whether Mega Garchomp's Earthquake can get through its bulk—running the damage math with roughly 222 Attack against an estimated Defense stat suggests it should deal solid but not guaranteed one-shot damage.

Earthquake likely won't KO Primarina, which could leave Garchomp vulnerable to a return Hyper Voice or Moonblast, so I'm weighing whether switching to Gholdengo is safer since it resists Fairy and takes Water neutrally, while also considering if Dragapult could clean up afterward. The safest line seems to be accepting Earthquake does heavy damage now and relying on Gholdengo or Dragapult to finish Primarina off next turn.
